title: Mar Kashisha, Son of Rava
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Shabbat 95a mentions him finding Rav Ashi suffering from the heat and asking, “Does the master not accept…?” etc. Shabbat 96a has Mar Kashisha, son of Rabbah, completing a teaching in Rabbi Eliezer’s name; Hyman proposes Elazar. Hyman says both places in older printings abbreviate the father’s name as רב׳, which copyists expanded to Rava in one passage and Rabbah in the other.

notes.text: The first scene has Rav Ashi suffering heat, not causing someone else pain with steam. The abbreviated רב׳ is part of the Rava/Rabbah textual problem; it is not a complete father’s name Rav.
The older-printing abbreviation and Eliezer-to-Elazar correction remain Hyman’s edition claims; the consulted Shabbat 95a directly supports the heat episode.
